    CASE WHEN om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh)) ELSE NULL END as availability,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM operational_metrics om
WHERE om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND om.mttrh IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    CASE WHEN om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh)) ELSE NULL END
ORDER BY availability;

args.sql:
-- Check minimum availability per plant
SELECT p.sitekey, p.sitelabel, 
       MIN(1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))) as min_availability,
       AVG(1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))) as avg_availability
FROM plants p
JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
WHERE om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND om.mttrh IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sitekey, p.sitelabel
ORDER BY min_availability ASC
LIMIT 20;

-- Check how many plants have availability below different thresholds
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE min_avail < 0.95) as below_95,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE min_avail < 0.97) as below_97,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE min_avail < 0.98) as below_98,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE min_avail < 0.99) as below_99,
    COUNT(*) as total
FROM (
    SELECT p.sitekey, MIN(1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))) as min_avail
    FROM plants p
    JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
    WHERE om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND om.mttrh IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.sitekey
) sub;

-- Calculate availability per plant and find those in the bottom tier
WITH plant_availability AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sitekey,
        p.sitelabel,
        MIN(1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))) as min_avail,
        AVG(1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))) as avg_avail,
        SUM(om.maintcost) as total_maintcost,
        AVG(om.mtbfh) as avg_mtbf,
        AVG(om.mttrh) as avg_mttr
    FROM plants p
    JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
    WHERE om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND om.mttrh IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.sitekey, p.sitelabel
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY avg_avail ASC) as decile
    FROM plant_availability
)
SELECT sitelabel, min_avail, avg_avail, total_maintcost, avg_mtbf, avg_mttr, decile
FROM ranked
WHERE decile = 1
ORDER BY avg_avail;

WITH plant_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sitekey,
        p.sitelabel,
        SUM(om.maintcost) as total_maintcost,
        AVG(om.mtbfh) as avg_mtbf,
        AVG(om.mttrh) as avg_mttr,
        AVG(1 - (om.mttrh::numeric / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))) as avg_availability
    FROM plants p
    JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
    WHERE om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND om.mttrh IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.sitekey, p.sitelabel
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_maintcost), 2) as avg_repair_cost
FROM plant_stats
WHERE avg_availability < 0.97;
